scanScriptsNote: Generator files are scanned for retired figures too, not just the prose they produce -- a build script that still hard-codes a retired figure (e.g. build_callouts.py's '0 of 56') will render it onto a slide the next time someone runs it, even though no prose file currently states it. Excluded from this scan: tools/tests/** (unit-test fixtures legitimately contain retired strings on purpose, see test_check_retired_figures.py), archive/** (retired scripts are kept for history, not run), node_modules/**, and .git/**.
